text: Samsung forecasts Q3 operating profit of 107.4 trillion won (+782% YoY) and revenue of 195 trillion won (+127% YoY). AI memory demand remains elevated amid tight supply and multiyear purchasing agreements. Shares decline following the preliminary release.

meta.note: Figures are preliminary; divisional earnings remain undisclosed.

text: The NFL files a Supreme Court amicus brief supporting New Jersey regulators against Kalshi. Federal appeals courts remain divided over state gambling jurisdiction and CFTC oversight of sports prediction contracts. The NFL supports state regulation and restrictions on contract categories and participant age.

meta.note: Jurisdiction remains unresolved; league preferences are recorded as formal positions, not operative rules.
